dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients from dark-grey perimeters to lighter-grey centers, predominantly distributed across the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity solid dark pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily situated along the upper dorsal ridge and interspersed between the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the central lateral region form an acute scalene triangle, with an additional linear alignment of three smaller nodes extending towards the posterior flipper.
